    About this study

    A browser sketch of the approved tantō forging flow, built to judge feel before porting to Roblox. It does not prove Roblox performance or EditableMesh access in a published game.

    Approved design it follows

    • Untimed circles: every strike counts, no misses, all strikes reach 90%.
    • Three stages: lengthen, taper and curve, form the point.
    • One universal blank, stretched to the tantō.
    • Quick, smooth deformation under the hammer, blending into neighbouring metal.
    • The blade slides, turns and flips by itself under a fixed hammer. No tongs.
    • Slightly angled overhead camera with the whole blade in view.
    • The 90% blade is clean, with a little excess edge and a dull finish.
    • Optional grinding can only improve the blade, stops at the target edge, and reaches 100%.

    Exploratory, not approved

    • 12 strikes and their order, positions, turns and flips.
    • Swing, deformation and repositioning timings (about 0.2 s swing, 0.09 s impact, 0.34 s move).
    • Exact tantō proportions, the blank's size, the tang, and the heat glow.
    • Quality per strike (7.5%) and grinding speed.
